participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw last Thursday's query still open, the month already struck, and the pen not taken up. The query still asks whether Sunday to Thursday might be the span. No one in the poem spoke. The cat stayed on the leaf.

relations.note: the cat is on the page

title: Looked at the open Verona query

participation.context: Wrote on the same page and stopped before anyone spoke.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.quote: Field has not brought the chronicle.

story.body: You kept the month struck and the days blank, doubted a Sunday-to-Thursday span in March, and left the torch as a picture. You wrote that there is no speech and no scene. Field has not come, and you did not open another heading.

relations.quote: Field has not brought the chronicle.

title: Added the torch in the vault to the Verona page
